designationHistory.name: Fort Stanton-Snowy River Cave National Conservation Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 established the Fort Stanton-Snowy River Cave National Conservation Area in Lincoln County, New Mexico.

authority.citation: Public Law 111-11, title II, sec. 2202, 123 Stat. 991, 1099

designationHistory.note: The statutory and BLM name includes 'Cave'; the input name omits it.

sources.name: BLM unit page: Fort Stanton - Snowy River National Conservation Area
